scientific_question: Can an independently calibrated semantic-choice channel provide a robust monotone ruler on fresh prompt families?

factorial_code_design.purpose: Separate semantic contrast, position bias, response-token bias, and their interaction.

mandatory_controls.code_mapping: Literal code-key questions must prefer the registered correct response in every factorial cell.
mandatory_controls.semantic_equality: Factorial-averaged target-oriented log odds for semantically identical descriptions define the independent null radius.
mandatory_controls.probability_order: Higher-probability copies of the same anchor lottery must dominate lower-probability copies.
mandatory_controls.anchor_dominance: BEST must dominate every cell and every cell must dominate WORST.
mandatory_controls.cold_start_replay: Every row is repeated after a process restart.

derived_instrument_radius.definition: The maximum absolute factorial-averaged semantic contrast on semantic-equality controls plus the maximum cold-start delta. Code-mapping and dominance rows are separate validity controls, not noise estimates.

fixed_sequence_gates.condition: All registered stochastic-dominance and anchor-dominance controls pass outside the derived instrument radius.
For every required ruler curve, d_inf is no larger than the derived instrument radius and both p=0 and p=1 endpoints force a zero crossing at that radius.
Every registered component/mixture tuple is jointly admitted by M0.

claim_boundary: This pilot can validate or reject one measurement channel. It cannot confirm mixture affinity, validate the v0.33 decision quotient on held-out behavior, authorize edits, or resolve ASMP-9.
